resources.string: Hide root, debugging and developer status from apps
Changes apply when affected apps next start. Reopen them or reboot.
Masks debugging state, root files and some system properties. Installed LineageOS apps and services stay visible. Reboot to fully apply changes.
Choose apps that should see developer options and debugging as off
Selected apps see developer options and USB or wireless debugging as disabled. Reopen an app after changing it here.
